name: Application Entry & Scene Routing
description: Bootstrap files and the scene router connecting React DOM to the 3D canvas, including the error boundary wrapping the canvas

name: Flight Scene
description: All components, shaders, AI logic, and assets that make up the 3D flight gameplay experience including player ship, enemies, projectiles, environment objects, HUD overlays, and transition scenes

name: Non-Flight Scenes
description: Bar, briefing, and quarters scenes plus all bar sub-views (arcade cabinet, bartender dialogue, commando conversations, and main navigation)

name: Shared UI Components
description: Reusable presentational components providing the game's retro sci-fi aesthetic: LCD panel container, CRT scanline overlay, and animated typewriter terminal text

name: Game State
description: Zustand stores managing global game mode and player health, combat simulation state (lasers, enemies, collisions), and mission lifecycle and scoring

name: Input Hooks
description: Hooks translating keyboard events into ref-based control state with zero re-renders, plus the key binding configuration store

name: 3D Model Assets
description: Binary GLB 3D model files for player ship, enemy spacecraft, asteroids, space mines, and the sun environment object

name: Debug Tooling & Utilities
description: Developer debug overlay with Leva GUI, debug feature-flag store, procedural Web Audio sound effects utility, and global stylesheet

name: Configuration
description: Build tooling and project configuration: Vite config, TypeScript compiler configs, NPM manifest, HTML entry point, Vite type declarations, Git LFS attributes, and tool ignore rules
